Author: XivHub [AetherFeed: xivhub/pluginmaster]
Name: AutoPincher
Description: Repinches your retainer market listings by undercutting the cheapest live competitor by 1 gil. Reads each listing straight from game memory, clicks the in-game market board's Compare Prices to find the current cheapest offering, and lowers your asking price to one below it (holding when your own listing is already cheapest). No server, no telemetry, nothing leaves your client. Adds an Auto Pinch button next to AutoRetainer's retainer-list controls and a /autopinch command for the open retainer. AutoRetainer is optional (used only to pause its automation during a pinch run).

Author: XivHub [AetherFeed: xivhub/pluginmaster]
Name: Gardener
Description: Keeps a persistent journal of every outdoor garden bed you own — personal, FC and shared estates — and reminds you when a crop needs tending, fertilizing or harvesting no matter where you are in the world. While standing at the plot, runs a guarded tend-all, fertilize-all, harvest-all or plant-a-plan sweep across the patch, and plans crossbreed layouts from a bundled dataset. Never travels, mounts or pathfinds on your behalf. This automates gameplay, which violates the FFXIV User Agreement and can get your account penalized or banned; use entirely at your own risk.

Author: XivHub [AetherFeed: xivhub/pluginmaster]
Name: GlamourLink
Description: Requires Glamourer. Paste an Eorzea Collection glamour URL or id and GlamourLink reads its gear list from Eorzea Collection's undocumented JSON endpoint, resolves it against the game's own item and dye sheets, and applies the result to your character through Glamourer's IPC. Unmatched items are reported rather than guessed silently, and every fuzzy-matched item is labelled as a guess. Optionally saves the result as a named Glamourer design. Saved outfits keep their resolved gear, so applying one needs no call to Eorzea Collection; open /glink library to browse them. Open /glink in game to import.

Author: Valenth Siveria [AetherFeed: Puni.sh/vali]
Name: I Am Ready
Description:
# I Am Ready

**I Am Ready** is a Dalamud plugin for Final Fantasy XIV that automatically accepts or declines Party and Alliance Ready Checks based on a customizable counter. 

Whether you are stepping away for a moment or just tired of clicking, this plugin handles ready checks for you while mimicking human reaction times.

## ✨ Features

* **Auto-Answer Ready Checks:** Automatically clicks "Yes" or "No" when a ready check appears.
* **Configurable "Yes" Counter:** Set a specific number of times you want to automatically answer "Yes". Once that limit is reached, the plugin will automatically start answering "No" to prevent pulling when you are actually away.
* **Natural Delay:** Enable a randomized delay (0.7 to 2.5 seconds) before the plugin answers, making it look like a natural human reaction.
* **Smart Chat Triggers (Regex):** Add custom text phrases to the plugin. If someone says one of these phrases in Party or Alliance chat (e.g., "reset", "pulling"), your counter will automatically reset back to zero.
* **Bilingual Support:** The user interface is available in both English and German.

## 🚀 Usage

1. Type `/iar` in the in-game chat to open the configuration window.
2. Click the **Inactive/Active** button at the top to turn the auto-responder on or off.
3. Adjust the **Yes Count** slider. For example, if set to `5`, the plugin will answer "Yes" to the next 5 ready checks, and "No" to any checks after that.
4. Click the **Start** button at any time to manually reset your current counter back to zero.

### Chat Triggers (Regex Patterns)
At the bottom of the window, you can expand the **Regex Patterns** section. Here you can add simple words or complex regex patterns. 
If the plugin reads a matching message in your Party or Cross-World Party chat, it will instantly reset your counter to zero, assuming a new pull or instance is starting!

/iar - opens the I Am Ready tool

Author: d12frosted [AetherFeed: d12frosted/autokill]
Name: AutoKill
Description:
Pick a mob, or pick an item you want it to drop, and AutoKill goes and farms it. It works out where the mob lives, teleports to the zone, mounts, flies over and kills its way around the field until you have what you asked for.

Search by mob name, or by item and see which mobs drop it. Set any mix of a kill count, a time limit and an amount of any item, and choose whether the first target ends the run or all of them must be met. Dying or filling your bags always ends it, and you get a chat line and a toast when it does.

It farms a whole field rather than one point, flying a circuit around it and moving on when a spot is cleared instead of standing over a respawn timer. How quickly a place comes back is not in any dataset, so it measures that as it goes and uses it to decide when a spot is worth returning to. Finished runs are kept so repeating one is a single click.

Movement needs vnavmesh. Fighting is handed to Wrath Combo, and left completely alone if your auto-rotation is already running.

Author: Akari [AetherFeed: dexcss/DalamudPlugins]
Name: Market Helper
Description:
Market Helper is an all-in-one market board tool with three tabs:

UNDERCUT — Stand near a summoning bell and press Run. It walks every retainer on the bell and undercuts each listed item to the lowest price. HQ/NQ handling, own-retainer protection, per-item overrides, and price memory within a run. Skips mannequin/display items (detected by the game's mannequin icon) so they're never touched or delisted.

LISTER — Build a list of items (hold CTRL and hover to quick-add, or search). Press Go and it walks the bell and lists them all, pricing each at the most common market price (ignoring lone troll/outlier listings) minus your undercut. Prices against your world, data center, or whole region. Handles the 20-item-per-retainer cap by rolling extra items to the next retainer. Includes a no-touch dry-run preview.

FLIPPER — Search any marketable item and compare prices across Japan, America, Europe and Materia via Universalis. Top 10 listings per region, best cross-region flip, and seller/buyer tax modeling.

Open with /markethelp, /market, /mh, or /undercut.

/trueping : open the settings window
/trueping overlay : toggle the floating overlay
/trueping dtr : toggle the server info bar entry
/trueping reset : clear the statistics

Author: jkleinne [AetherFeed: jkleinne/ascended-plugins]
Name: Ascended Rotation Solver Reborn
Description:
Personal fork of RotationSolverReborn that adds PvPSmart, a scoring-based PvP target selector. PvE behavior matches upstream.

The stock PvP cycle ranks targets by absolute current HP, which biases toward tanks over genuinely vulnerable squishies. PvPSmart composes weighted factors (role value, effective HP, finish-kill bias, mitigation penalty, distance, hysteresis, crystal carrier, LB cast, isolation, threat) and skips invuln targets entirely, producing more focus-fire-friendly target selection in Crystalline Conflict.

Use only if you specifically want the PvPSmart targeting mode. For general use, install upstream RotationSolverReborn instead.

Author: Kaliya [AetherFeed: Liquidize/ActionMeThis]
Name: ActionMeThis
Description:
Congratulations, you have installed a plugin whose entire purpose is to press buttons in Penumbra so that you do not have to. A proud day.

How it works, since you were going to ask: it watches your character - weapon drawn, sat down, mounted, swimming, loitering within eight yalms of someone you tolerate - and flips mod settings to match. You can stack conditions, because naturally one was never going to be enough. "Weapon drawn AND near a friend AND not in combat" is, apparently, a thing you needed. It works. Nobody is asking questions.

It also puts every setting back afterwards, so your mod list survives contact with your own decisions. You are welcome.

Not liable for redraws at dramatically inconvenient moments, or for the dawning realisation that your character now has better situational awareness than you do.

Author: Kaliya [AetherFeed: Liquidize/Wyu2]
Name: Wyu2
Description:
Wyu2 - "what you up to?" - shows friends who opted in on a radar, on the zone map, and in a live activity list: which zone and public instance they are in, which duty they are running, which job they are playing, and whether they are fighting, gathering, crafting, queueing or just idling in Limsa.

Nobody appears until they opt in. You swap share codes, both sides accept, and even then nothing leaves your machine until you turn sharing on and tick the fields you want to send. Each update is encrypted separately for each recipient, so a relay only ever moves blobs it cannot read. Point it at your own relay - one ships with the source - and delete your account whenever you like.

Commands: /wyu2 for the friend list, /wyu2 radar, /wyu2 map, /wyu2 config, /wyu2 share on|off, /wyu2 pause [minutes], /wyu2 note <text>.

Docket reads the deliveries the game already asks of you and hands them to Vulcan.

It lists the craftable items required by your accepted levequests, and by the Grand Company supply window while it is open. Uncheck what you do not want, then send the rest as a Vulcan crafting list. Vulcan resolves precrafts, materials and gathering on its own.

Docket reads. It never crafts, gathers, buys, or writes into another plugin's configuration file.

Description: Cumulative counter of completed FATEs. Survives relogs, game restarts and plugin reloads. Only goes back to zero via the Reset button or /fate reset. Built for Demiatma farming: when one drops, the count is frozen in a pending entry so the number stays correct even if you keep farming.

Author: MedianAura [AetherFeed: MedianAura/FFXIV-MedianAura]
Name: Sift
Description:
Sift puts your own criteria on top of the item lists the game already shows you.

In your bags: pick the categories and bounds you care about, save them as named loadouts, and the matching slots are tinted in the native inventory window. Items reserved by a gearset are counted and protected, glamours included.

At a counter: rows that fail your filter are greyed out and cannot be bought by accident. Filter by equip level, by class job, or by which stats an item carries -- and the Current button reads your own equipped gear to set all three at once.

Covers the ordinary vendor and the Grand Company seal exchange. It moves items only when you ask it to entrust them.

Author: MedianAura [AetherFeed: MedianAura/FFXIV-MedianAura]
Name: SquadronScribe
Description:
SquadronScribe reads your Grand Company squadron and writes the import code that ffxivsquadron.com expects.

Open the Squadron Members window at your barracks and an Export button appears beside it. One click copies the code; paste it into the site's import box.

SquadronScribe reads. It never assigns, trains, dismisses, or sends a mission.

Author: Midona [AetherFeed: midona-rhel/Poser]
Name: Poser
Description:
Poser is a posing and scene tool for FINAL FANTASY XIV's group pose.

- Pose actors bone by bone: overlay handles, a graphical body map, and numeric transforms
- IK on any bone with a parent, plus mirror, link and named bone-visibility presets
- Spawn actors and objects, or click a world handle to bring what is already there into the scene
- Borrow the map's own objects by reference and give them back untouched on release
- Save and restore the whole shot — actors, objects, lights, camera and environment — with load options
- Custom lights, camera control and a free camera; snapping, group pivot and group moves
- Gaze control and one-click expressions
- A pose library with tags, authors and search; import and export poses, and MCDF appearance files
- Time, weather and festival control
- On-screen dialogue panels, chat bubbles and status lines drawn with the game's own UI
- Reference pictures as floating, aspect-locked windows
- Twenty-five rebindable actions with Poser, Brio and Ktisis presets

This is a beta. It is not stable and it is not finished. Poser is derivative of Anamnesis, Ktisis and Brio, and those three are the mature tools.

Poser was coded with the use of artificial intelligence. The plugin says so on first launch and asks you to confirm before the workspace opens.

Author: Sanaka [AetherFeed: miralsoft/Dalamud-Plugins]
Name: Gearbook
Description:
The game lists your gearsets by name and nothing else. Gearbook adds what that list is missing: a search, filters by role and category, favourites, your own tags and notes, and a compact bar of job icons you can leave on screen and click to switch. A switcher on the front of the bar swaps it between your favourites, one role, one category or one of your own tags without opening a window.

It is built for the case the game handles worst, several sets for the same job, so a dark knight for one fight, another for a different one, and a third for a glamour are three separate entries rather than one guess. Rename them, reorder them, delete one, and your tags and notes stay on the right sets.

It can also tidy the game's own gearset list into the order Gearbook shows, which is the one thing it changes rather than reads. That runs only when you press the button, keeps the order it found so you can put it back, and stops at the first move that does not land where it was aimed.

Otherwise nothing happens on its own. Gearbook switches a gearset only when you click or type, and there is no automation, no queueing and no acting on your behalf while you are away. It needs no account, no server and no internet connection. Nothing leaves your machine.

Author: NoctusDev [AetherFeed: NoctusDev/buddys-buddy]
Name: Buddy's Buddy
Description:
Buddy's Buddy is a host for small, self-contained modules. Each module is its own mini-plugin with its own tab, settings and commands, and can be enabled or disabled independently.

Buddy's Bag empties the chocobo saddlebag into your inventory.
Buddy's Chest tallies the whole free company chest and withdraws every unit of a chosen item.
Buddy's Slaves tallies every retainer and withdraws a shopping list of items, taking as much as each retainer can supply before moving on.

Author: NoctusDev [AetherFeed: NoctusDev/DalamudPlugins]
Name: Buddy's Buddy
Description:
Buddy's Buddy is a host for small, self-contained modules. Each module is its own mini-plugin with its own tab, settings and commands, and can be enabled or disabled independently.

Buddy's Bag empties the chocobo saddlebag into your inventory.
Buddy's Chest tallies the whole free company chest and withdraws every unit of a chosen item.
Buddy's Slaves tallies every retainer and withdraws a shopping list of items, taking as much as each retainer can supply before moving on.
Buddy's Desynther desynthesises from your bags and armoury chest and keeps a ledger of the yields.
Buddy's Stash searches everything you own, everywhere it is, from one box.
Buddy's Purse totals your gil across character, retainers and the free company chest.

Author: NoctusDev [AetherFeed: NoctusDev/DalamudPlugins]
Name: MarketTraveler
Description:
Buying, not selling. Give MarketTraveler a shopping list with a price ceiling per item and it works the market board for you: searches each item, skips anything over your ceiling, and reports what it actually bought — counted from your bags, not from the listing.

Shopping always happens in Limsa Lominsa, on whichever world it travels to.

Requires both Lifestream (world travel) and vnavmesh (walking the ~50 yalms from the aetheryte to the board). The Dependencies tab checks both are installed and that their IPC actually answers, and blocks a run if either would fail.

Name: Line Me Up
Description: Walks your character onto the spot a target is standing on, then turns you to face the same way they do. Movement is real: your character walks there under its own power, easing off speed on the final approach so it settles on the mark rather than overshooting it. Supports a target-relative offset, a facing offset, and a continuous follow mode that keeps you on their mark as they move. Built for lining up at close quarters - there is no pathfinding.

Author: OmegaJackie [AetherFeed: OmegaJackie/DalamudPlugins]
Name: Relicable
Description:
EARLY ALPHA - an access code from the developer is required to run this plugin; it will not start without one.

Data-driven automation engine for the ARR Zodiac relic line (A Relic Reborn through Zodiac Zeta). It plans and drives the stage objectives - Atma FATE farming, Animus book leves and dungeons, Novus materia/scroll planning, Nexus light farming, and the Jalzahn/Gerolt upgrade turn-ins - by orchestrating other plugins over IPC rather than replacing them.

Requires these companion plugins, installed and working: vnavmesh (movement), BossMod Reborn, Rotation Solver Reborn or Wrath Combo (combat), Lifestream (aetheryte travel), TextAdvance (dialogue), and AutoDuty (dungeons). The Dependencies tab in /relic config shows live status for each.

USE AT YOUR OWN RISK: automating movement and combat is botting under the FINAL FANTASY XIV User Agreement, and Square Enix suspends and terminates accounts for it. The risk is highest for the open-world stages (Atma, Animus, Nexus, Zeta), which run in shared content where other players can observe and report you. Neither this plugin nor its authors can reduce that risk or protect you from it.

This is alpha software that takes control of your character for long unattended sessions. It is incomplete, it has rough edges, and stages will occasionally stall and need manual help. Do not run it unattended if that is not acceptable to you. Bug reports should include /xllog output with 'Enable debug log' turned on in /relic config.

Allows for a macro to continue onto the next macro by using '/nextmacro' on the last line of a macro.

Adding '/nextmacro down' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #11
Also allows executing any macro from chat using '/runmacro'
You can repeat a macro by using /runmacro inside the macro followed by the number of the macro you're editing
Using '/macrocancel' will stop the currently running macro

Description: Tracks damage dealt, healing done, DPS, HPS, overhealing, damage taken, and more in real time for you and your party. Stores up to 20 recent combat sessions with manual save slots. Fully configurable display, bar colors, and window styles.

Author: Sansflaire [AetherFeed: Sansflaire/FFXIV-TV]
Name: FFXIV-TV
Description:
Places a virtual screen in 3D world space that displays images and video with proper depth testing. Supports local files, direct URLs, YouTube (via yt-dlp), and multi-player sync so all players with the plugin see the same content simultaneously.

Note: yt-dlp.exe must be placed in the plugin folder for YouTube support.

Author: Sansflaire [AetherFeed: Sansflaire/LimLoToolkit]
Name: LimLo Toolkit
Description: LimLoToolkit is a single window that collects small quality-of-life tools for the Occult Crescent and beyond. Coffer Lines draws a line from you to nearby bronze and silver treasure coffers, and can optionally target and open one once you walk up to it. Enemy Vision draws each nearby enemy's detection area on the ground - a wedge for enemies that only see in front, a circle for those that detect in all directions - and turns it red when you are standing inside. Alongside them sit a live character and zone readout and an Eorzea clock with the next weather window. Every tool can be switched on or off individually. The plugin is fully standalone - it needs no other plugins installed and talks to nothing outside the game.

Author: Sansflaire [AetherFeed: Sansflaire/LocalCollidables]
Name: Local Collidables
Description: Hooks the RMI (raw movement input) pipeline to intercept player movement before it reaches the game server. When the player attempts to walk into a registered barrier volume (placed around locally-visible props), the movement component pointing into the barrier is zeroed and a sliding response is computed. The server only ever sees the player stop moving naturally.

Author: Sansflaire [AetherFeed: Sansflaire/LocalWorld]
Name: Local World
Description: Spawns static game models (rocks, trees, furniture, environmental props) into the game world that only the local player can see. Uses direct actor spawn functions from FFXIVClientStructs. All spawned actors are tracked and cleaned up on zone change, logout, and plugin unload. Supports optional host/client sync so other players running LocalWorld can see the same props.

Author: Sansflaire [AetherFeed: Sansflaire/PanacheUI]
Name: PanacheUI
Description: PanacheUI is a vector graphics UI framework for Dalamud plugins, backed by SkiaSharp (the same engine as Chrome and Flutter). Provides a node tree, CSS-like styling, layout engine, and smooth rendering — far beyond what vanilla ImGui can offer.

Author: Sansflaire [AetherFeed: Sansflaire/TieriChallengesFFXIV-Public]
Name: FFXIV Miscellaneous Challenges
Description: A tracker for miscellaneous self-imposed FFXIV challenges across combat, exploration, gathering, crafting and social play. Challenges complete themselves when their conditions are met - walk a route, emote at a spot, ride a particular mount somewhere, or wear a full outfit in a given zone - and a popup celebrates each one. Progress is kept per install with the date you finished each challenge, and a separate permanent record means a reset is always recoverable. Includes a suggestion button for sending ideas straight to the developer. Commands: /tchallenges, /tchal

Author: Raiden Shinryu [AetherFeed: sleousis/DawntrailReady]
Name: Dawntrail Ready
Description:
Updates mods made before Dawntrail (7.0) the same way TexTools does, without TexTools. Requires Penumbra.

- Import a mod in Penumbra as usual: if it was made before Dawntrail, its models, materials and textures are updated in the background and Penumbra reloads it. Nothing to click.
- Scan your whole Penumbra library, see which mods are pre-Dawntrail, and update them all at once.
- Convert a .pmp or .ttmp2 file: the updated copy is saved next to it as "(Dawntrail).pmp" and imported into Penumbra.

Mods that already work in Dawntrail are never touched. Files are changed in place and no backup is kept.

Commands: /dtready (window), /dtready scan, /dtready convert <file>

The conversion is ported from TexTools' xivModdingFramework. Dawntrail Ready is free software under the GPL-3.0, like TexTools.

Author: Raiden Shinryu [AetherFeed: sleousis/Gleam]
Name: Gleam
Description:
Gleam cleans and organizes your inventory, and does the walking itself.

Clean: it finds junk in your bags, armoury chest, saddlebag, retainers and glamour dresser and shows it in one list. You choose whether to sell on the market board, sell to vendors or discard, then press one button.

Organize: layouts move the items you keep to where you want them. For example, materia to the saddlebag, spare gear to a retainer and gear-set pieces to the armoury chest.

Nothing is changed until you press the button. Items that will be cleaned or moved are highlighted in the game's bag windows. Gleam then opens the saddlebag, travels to an inn for your retainers and the dresser, and visits your Grand Company when something is to be turned in.

Please note: Gleam moves your character and clicks through the game's menus for you. Square Enix's terms of service do not allow third-party tools, and automation is what they act against most. Use it at your own risk. Organizing is still a preview and has not had a full test in game.

Commands: /gleam or /gl. Sub-commands: organize, history, settings, stop, selftest, report.

Plugins Gleam needs:
vnavmesh walks your character from place to place. Gleam needs it.
Lifestream teleports between aetherytes and into inns. Without it, start a run while you are already in an inn.

Optional:
AutoRetainer lets Gleam discard junk after each retainer's ventures.
Allagan Tools shows retainer contents without summoning them.
Market prices come from Universalis and need an internet connection.

Author: Raiden Shinryu [AetherFeed: sleousis/Soundswap]
Name: Soundswap
Description:
Make a music mod in a minute, without leaving the game. Requires Penumbra.

- Pick any of the game's songs from the list (names come from Orchestrion's song list), or press Replace on what is playing now.
- Drop in your own song: MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC, M4A, AAC, MP4, WMA and more. Soundswap converts it the way the game stores music, matches its volume to the song it replaces and sets up the loop.
- Layered songs (the ones the game fades between during a fight) get a choice per layer: your song, silence, or the game's own layer.
- Build & install puts the mod in Penumbra and switches it on; with Orchestrion installed, Play in game plays it straight away. Or export a .pmp to share.

Commands: /soundswap

Author: OhKannaDuh (fork maintained by T3chnicalD3ath) [AetherFeed: t3knical/DalamudPlugins]
Name: Occult Helper
Description:
OccultHelper is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: occulthelper (alias: och)
  /occulthelper → Opens the main window
  /occulthelper config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /occulthelper config list → Lists config keys
  /occulthelper config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /occulthelper config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /occulthelper buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /occulthelper tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /occulthelper illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /occulthelper cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /occulthelper cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /occulthelper cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /occulthelper reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /occulthelper (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)

Author: rico [AetherFeed: wolfricoz/ThoseDamnRetainers]
Name: Those Damn Retainers
Description:
A panel that clips onto the retainer windows and does the fetching, stowing and pricing in bulk.

- Lists what is in the open retainer and what is in your own bags, with a search and a category filter
- Type an amount per item, or take everything the filters are showing, press OK, and the batch is carried across
- Works both ways: retrieve from the retainer, or stow into it
- Saved lists, either as an exact amount or as a 'top me up to N' target
- Build a list straight from a crafting recipe: pick the craft and the number of runs
- Put items up for sale undercutting the competition, with prices from universalis.app
- Reprice every listing of an item at once, which matters for things that can only be listed one at a time

You open the retainer yourself; the plugin never walks anywhere or clicks through NPC menus.

Every request is throttled and verified before the next is sent, and everything that changes game state goes through a single checked gateway: nothing is sent that the game's own interface would refuse. The first time you reprice or list something it changes one and stops, so you can confirm it took before the rest follows.

Author: yocopk [AetherFeed: yocopk/moghouse-dalamud]
Name: MogHouse Companion
Description:
Companion plugin for MogHouse (mog-house.com).

An all-in-one home for quality-of-life tools that link FINAL FANTASY XIV to your MogHouse account. Tools are added over time; each one can be switched on or off individually, and nothing leaves the game unless you enable it.

Timers: reads the timers you already see in the game's own Timers window (CTRL+U), including submarine and airship voyages, retainer ventures, map and leve allowances, custom deliveries and allied society dailies, and syncs them to your profile. MogHouse then pushes you a notification the moment one comes up, on web and mobile, even while the game and your PC are off. Voyages are timed to the last vessel back, so one notification means the whole fleet is home.

Duty Finder: when the confirm window appears, MogHouse pushes the duty or roulette name to your phone, so you know whether it is worth the sprint back to the desk. By default it stays quiet while the game is the window you are looking at.

The plugin is read-only: it collects your own data and reports status. It never performs an in-game action — it will not commence a duty for you, and it does not skip, confirm or automate anything.

Open it with /moghouse. Requires a MogHouse account, and a free one is enough: it syncs one character and sends one timer alert of your choosing, plus duty pops. Mog+ lifts both limits and warns you before a timer lands rather than as it does.

Author: okaminico (based on ffxiv-tc-port's fork of TataruPraise) [AetherFeed: zodiac0806/TataruPraise-TC]
Name: 塔塔露誇獎
Description:
遊戲裡發生事情的時候，用塔塔露的聲音喊一句極短的提示——「完美收工！」「後面！」「排到了！」。不是要太多對話，只是要有聲音。每個情境一句、全部 8 個字以內，情境有副本完成／升等／登入／Gil 里程碑／血量低／背後有人／收到密語／副本排到／組隊邀請／交易請求等，各自獨立開關（預設全部關閉）。播的是事先合成好的語音檔，執行期完全不連網。語音來自本機的 GPT-SoVITS 橋接（預設 http://127.0.0.1:9882），沒有橋接就只是不出聲，不會卡遊戲。設定視窗可以直接編輯每個情境的短句；資訊列上有一格，點一下切換總開關。指令 /tataru 開啟設定視窗，/tataru test 試播一句。

本版本修正了離開等級壓制的副本／大型任務時，明明只是恢復原本等級卻被誤判成升等而喊出語音的問題。
